title: Unraveling the refolding dynamics, TLR2 interaction, and immunomodulatory insights of OmpA from Salmonella Typhimurium.
authors: Chaudhari, Rahul; Nigam, Deveish; Dasgupta, Mallar; Chandravanshi, Khileshwari; Malik, Kritika; Kodgire, Prashant
one_liner_zh: 研究沙门氏菌OmpA蛋白的复性动力学、TLR2互作及免疫调节，涉及蛋白-蛋白对接而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium is a Gram-negative bacterium that causes gastrointestinal infection and rising antibiotic resistance worldwide. This study examines the structural-functional relationship of OmpA, a major outer membrane protein (OMP) implicated in Salmonella pathogenesis. Computational analysis revealed a high conservation of OmpA among the Enterobacteriaceae family. Due to its beta-sheet-rich structure, OmpA forms inclusion bodies during overexpression. To mitigate this, solubilization under high-pH conditions and refolding with Lauryl dimethylamine N-oxide (LDAO) effectively preserves its native-like conformation. Semi-native SDS-PAGE and size exclusion chromatography suggest that OmpA exists as a dimer. Circular dichroism and heat modifiability analyses further confirmed its beta-sheet-rich secondary structure, consistent with a beta-barrel fold. However, high-resolution studies are required to confirm its oligomeric state and barrel architecture. These insights facilitate the selection of refolding processes and support investigations into the structure and function of OmpA. Functionally, in silico docking and in vitro assays revealed OmpA interaction with TLR2 from HEp-2 and Raji human B-cells. OmpA stimulation activates NFkB signaling in B-cells, leading to increased expression of proinflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha and upregulation of activation-induced cytidine deaminase (AID), a key enzyme involved in enhancing antibody diversity. Moreover, an immunoinformatic analysis has identified B-cell and T-cell epitopes within OmpA's extracellular domain, highlighting its potential as a vaccine candidate. Notably, immune simulations demonstrate that OmpA enhances both innate and adaptive immune responses. This response promotes memory cell generation and may contribute to bacterial clearance. Collectively, this study provides a foundation for future therapeutics against S. Typhimurium pathogenesis.
abstract_zh: 肠炎沙门氏菌鼠伤寒血清型（Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium）是一种革兰氏阴性细菌，可引起胃肠道感染，并在全球范围内导致抗生素耐药性上升。本研究探讨了OmpA（一种与沙门氏菌致病性相关的主要外膜蛋白（OMP））的结构-功能关系。计算分析显示，OmpA在肠杆菌科（Enterobacteriaceae）中具有高度保守性。由于其富含β-折叠的结构，OmpA在过表达过程中会形成包涵体。为缓解这一问题，在高pH条件下溶解并用月桂基二甲基胺N-氧化物（LDAO）复性，可有效保持其类天然构象。半天然SDS-PAGE和尺寸排阻色谱表明，OmpA以二聚体形式存在。圆二色谱和热修饰性分析进一步确认了其富含β-折叠的二级结构，与β-桶状折叠一致。然而，需要高分辨率研究来确认其寡聚状态和桶状结构。这些见解有助于选择复性过程，并支持对OmpA结构和功能的研究。在功能上，计算机模拟对接和体外实验揭示了OmpA与来自HEp-2和Raji人B细胞的TLR2相互作用。OmpA刺激激活B细胞中的NFkB信号通路，导致促炎细胞因子（如TNF-α）表达增加，并上调激活诱导的胞苷脱氨酶（AID），这是一种参与增强抗体多样性的关键酶。此外，免疫信息学分析已识别出OmpA胞外域中的B细胞和T细胞表位，突显其作为疫苗候选者的潜力。值得注意的是，免疫模拟表明，OmpA增强先天性和适应性免疫反应。这种反应促进记忆细胞生成，并可能有助于细菌清除。总体而言，本研究为未来针对鼠伤寒沙门氏菌致病性的治疗策略奠定了基础。
